name: PT Buana Finance Tbk
summary: PT Buana Finance Tbk provides investment, working capital, and multipurpose financing services in Indonesia. It operates through Finance Lease Receivables and Consumer Financing Receivables segments. The company offers financing services for various products, including heavy equipment, such as excavators, wheel loaders, tractors, and heavy trucks; generators and forklifts; printing and industrial machineries; consumer cars and commercial vehicles (trucks); vessels; Hajj/Umrah; education; tour traveling/vacation; and others, as well as sale and leaseback services.
